## Motivation

An agent can keep one full tool declaration and choose which tools are available for each turn. For example, a read-only step can expose `search` while leaving `deploy` unavailable. Chat currently rejects the `tool_choice.type=allowed_tools` request needed to express that subset.

Accept a declared function subset with `auto` or `required` mode, including declarations in root/system/developer messages.

Resolve the subset during request validation so encoders, constrained decoding and output parsers see the same selected declarations and mode. Carry the explicit mode into copied template kwargs so null hints and server defaults cannot change it. Generic Jinja templates also receive message-level tool schemas through their `tools` argument; native encoders keep the original message scopes. Historical calls/results and caller inputs are preserved. Reject duplicate/undeclared references, empty required subsets and conflicting template choices.

The Rust gateway has separate handling (#11085); this change covers Python serving. The K3 cookbook documents the request shape.

## Test Plan

- Protocol regressions cover filtering, validation, serialization and input preservation. Focused serving unit tests reproduce the missing message schemas on `e3c61ad` and pass with the fix, alongside named/none/empty-auto, Muse, K3 and DSV controls. Repository Ruff checks and formatting pass.
- Ran complete `e3c61ad` and `8d9a9d0` servers on one NVIDIA B30Z with genuine BF16 Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct, Torch 2.14.1+cu130, sglang-kernel 0.4.10 and FlashInfer 0.7.2. Required subsets, excluded-tool prompts, null/default mode hints, empty-auto and root declarations pass through real HTTP/SSE generation. Invalid requests hit the corresponding production validation errors.
- A disclosed test-only zero-output Jinja prefix checks rendered names, schemas and modes. Real tokenizer checks confirm accepted prompts are byte-identical to the stock template, with and without diagnostic kwargs. The baseline exposes the missing root declarations; the fix generates `keep({})`. Temporary servers were cleaned up and all 24 resident GPU PIDs were preserved.

This covers generic Python Chat integration. Full K3 weights/native generation, performance and SLA are outside this run; upstream hardware CI still needs `run-ci`.

Prepared with Codex assistance.

 <Note>
 No preset has a full serving round on final weights; the constants derive from measured single- and dual-node rounds plus a 64-GPU sweep. Validate throughput and accuracy on your workload before committing a fleet.
 </Note>
+
+
+## Restrict the callable tool set
+
+Chat Completions accepts a function subset through `tool_choice`:
+
+```json
+{
+  "tool_choice": {
+    "type": "allowed_tools",
+    "allowed_tools": {
+      "mode": "required",
+      "tools": [{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "get_weather"}}]
+    }
+  }
+}
+```
+
+Declare each referenced function in `tools` or a root/system/developer message's
+`tools` list. The server filters these declarations before prompt encoding,
+constrained decoding and output parsing, then uses `auto` or `required` as the
+normal tool-choice mode. Historical tool calls and results are preserved.
+The selected mode also takes precedence over server chat-template defaults.
+Duplicate or undeclared names, an empty required subset, and a conflicting
+`chat_template_kwargs.tool_choice` are rejected. An empty `auto` subset is valid.

+    @model_validator(mode="after")
+    def resolve_allowed_tools(self):
+        if not isinstance(self.tool_choice, AllowedToolChoice):
+            return self
+        allowed = self.tool_choice.allowed_tools
+        names = [tool.function.name for tool in allowed.tools]
+        if len(names) != len(set(names)):
+            raise ValueError("allowed_tools function names must be unique")
+        declared = list(self.tools or [])
+        for message in self.messages:
+            if isinstance(
+                message, ChatCompletionMessageGenericParam
+            ) and message.role in ("root", "system", "developer"):
+                declared.extend(message.tools or [])
+        unknown = set(names) - {tool.function.name for tool in declared}
+        if unknown:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "allowed_tools references undeclared functions: "
+                + ", ".join(sorted(unknown))
+            )
+        if allowed.mode == "required" and not names:
+            raise ValueError("allowed_tools must not be empty in required mode")
+        template_kwargs = dict(self.chat_template_kwargs or {})
+        template_choice = template_kwargs.get("tool_choice")
+        if template_choice is not None and template_choice != allowed.mode:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "chat_template_kwargs.tool_choice conflicts with allowed_tools.mode"
+            )
+        # Carry the explicit mode into rendering too: null template hints and
+        # server defaults must not replace the choice used by output parsers.
+        template_kwargs["tool_choice"] = allowed.mode
+        self.chat_template_kwargs = template_kwargs
+        # Normalize once, before prompt encoders, grammars and output parsers
+        # consume the request. Historical tool calls are left intact.
+        allowed_names = set(names)
+        if self.tools is not None:
+            self.tools = [
+                tool for tool in self.tools if tool.function.name in allowed_names
+            ]
+        self.messages = [
+            message.model_copy(
+                update={
+                    "tools": [
+                        tool
+                        for tool in message.tools
+                        if tool.function.name in allowed_names
+                    ]
+                }
+            )
+            if isinstance(message, ChatCompletionMessageGenericParam)
+            and message.role in ("root", "system", "developer")
+            and message.tools is not None
+            else message
+            for message in self.messages
+        ]
+        self.tool_choice = allowed.mode
+        return self
+

+                            "content": "",
+                            "tools": [
+                                self._message_render_tool("keep"),
+                                self._message_render_tool("drop"),
+                            ],
+                        },
+                        {
+                            "role": "assistant",
+                            "tool_calls": [
+                                {
+                                    "id": "old-call",
+                                    "type": "function",
+                                    "function": {"name": "drop", "arguments": "{}"},
+                                }
+                            ],
+                        },
+                        {"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": "old-call", "content": "done"},
+                        {"role": "user", "content": "Call keep."},
+                    ]
+                    original_messages = json.loads(json.dumps(messages))
+                    tools = (
+                        [
+                            self._message_render_tool("top_keep"),
+                            self._message_render_tool("top_drop"),
+                        ]
+                        if mixed
+                        else None
+                    )
+                    names = ["top_keep", "keep"] if mixed else ["keep"]
+                    request = ChatCompletionRequest(
+                        model="x",
+                        messages=messages,
+                        tools=tools,
+                        tool_choice={
+                            "type": "allowed_tools",
+                            "allowed_tools": {
+                                "mode": "required",
+                                "tools": [
+                                    {"type": "function", "function": {"name": name}}
+                                    for name in names
+                                ],
+                            },
+                        },
+                    )
+                    expected_tools = [
+                        tool.model_dump() for tool in request.tools or []
+                    ] + [tool.model_dump() for tool in request.messages[0].tools]
+
+                    self.chat._process_messages(request, is_multimodal=False)
+
+                    call = self.tm.tokenizer.apply_chat_template.call_args
+                    self.assertEqual(call.kwargs["tools"], expected_tools)
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        [tool["function"]["name"] for tool in call.kwargs["tools"]],
+                        names,
+                    )
+                    self.assertEqual(call.kwargs["tool_choice"], "required")
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        call.args[0][1]["tool_calls"][0]["function"]["name"], "drop"
+                    )
+                    self.assertEqual(messages, original_messages)
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        [tool.function.name for tool in request.messages[0].tools],
+                        ["keep"],
+                    )
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        [tool.function.name for tool in request.tools or []],
+                        ["top_keep"] if mixed else [],
+                    )
+
+    def test_jinja_message_tools_respect_none_and_empty_allowed_subset(self):
+        self.template_manager.chat_template_name = None
+        self.template_manager.jinja_template_content_format = "string"
+        self.chat.chat_encoding_spec = None
+        for choice in (
+            "none",
+            {
+                "type": "allowed_tools",
+                "allowed_tools": {"mode": "auto", "tools": []},
+            },
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(choice=choice):
+                request = ChatCompletionRequest(
+                    messages=[
+                        {
+                            "role": "root",
+                            "content": "",
+                            "tools": [self._message_render_tool("drop")],
+                        },
+                        {"role": "user", "content": "Hi."},
+                    ],
+                    tool_choice=choice,
+                )
+
+                self.chat._process_messages(request, is_multimodal=False)
+
+                self.assertIsNone(
+                    self.tm.tokenizer.apply_chat_template.call_args.kwargs["tools"]
+                )
+
+    def test_jinja_named_message_tool_is_rendered(self):
+        self.template_manager.chat_template_name = None
+        self.template_manager.jinja_template_content_format = "string"
+        self.chat.chat_encoding_spec = None
+        request = ChatCompletionRequest(
+            messages=[
+                {
+                    "role": "root",
+                    "content": "",
+                    "tools": [
+                        self._message_render_tool("keep"),
+                        self._message_render_tool("drop"),
+                    ],
+                },
+                {"role": "user", "content": "Call keep."},
+            ],
+            tools=[self._message_render_tool("top_drop")],
+            tool_choice=ToolChoice(function=ToolChoiceFuncName(name="keep")),
+        )
+
+        self.chat._process_messages(request, is_multimodal=False)
+
+        rendered = self.tm.tokenizer.apply_chat_template.call_args.kwargs["tools"]
+        self.assertEqual(rendered, [request.messages[0].tools[0].model_dump()])
+
+    def test_jinja_message_tools_preserve_muse_template_override(self):
+        self.template_manager.chat_template_name = None
+        self.template_manager.jinja_template_content_format = "string"
+        self.chat.chat_encoding_spec = None
+        self.chat.tool_call_parser = "muse"
+        request = ChatCompletionRequest(
+            messages=[
+                {
+                    "role": "root",
+                    "content": "",
+                    "tools": [self._message_render_tool("message_tool")],
+                },
+                {"role": "user", "content": "Hi."},
+            ],
+            tools=[self._message_render_tool("codex.keep")],
+        )
+        template_tools = [
+            {
+                "type": "namespace",
+                "name": "codex",
+                "tools": [self._message_render_tool("keep")],
+            }
+        ]
+        request._template_tools = template_tools
+
+        self.chat._apply_jinja_template(request, template_tools, is_multimodal=False)
+
+        rendered = self.tm.tokenizer.apply_chat_template.call_args.kwargs["tools"]
+        self.assertEqual(rendered, template_tools)
+        self.assertIs(request._template_tools, template_tools)
+
     def test_glm47_without_tools_has_no_tool_call_constraint(self):
         """A plain GLM47 chat must not get the full-assistant EBNF: its
         terminal state finishes the request even under ignore_eos."""
